verdict.rationale: Elicit's Systematic Reviews workflow produces a research report summarizing papers, includes data extraction and screening tables, and both reports and tables can be exported as PDF/Word/CSV/Excel for sharing with stakeholders (elicit-docs-1, elicit-docs-22, elicit-docs-47, elicit-docs-19, elicit-docs-25). The Research Agent can also produce documents, tables, and figures within a session (elicit-docs-9, elicit-docs-21, elicit-docs-33). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration that the exported report format is polished enough for external stakeholder sharing, and no evidence of customizable report sectioning beyond the standard systematic-review structure.
